meta.title: Eligibility check — OrentaLoan
meta.description: In a few questions, an honest reading of your file: serious prospect, file to strengthen, or not feasible as it stands. Guidance, not a credit decision.

intro.title: The Reading of your file
intro.subtitle: Seven questions, two minutes. We tell you honestly where your file stands, with the reason and the paths that remain.
intro.note: This is guidance, not a credit decision. No score, no commitment, no data shared without your agreement.

seniority.label: How long have you been in this situation?

monthlyCharges.label: Your monthly expenses and loans
monthlyCharges.help: Rent, maintenance, instalments on loans already running.

incident.label: Is a payment incident registered in your name?
incident.help: Listing on a national credit-incident register.

go.label: Serious prospect
go.description: The elements gathered allow an application to be studied.

work.label: File to strengthen
work.description: One specific point holds you back today. It can be lifted.

stop.label: Not feasible as it stands
stop.description: Financing is not realistic today. Here is more useful guidance.

result.title: Your Reading
result.note: This reading is guidance, not a credit decision. Only the review of your full file is authoritative.

reasons.insufficientCapacity: As it stands, the declared income does not cover a new instalment without straining your budget.
reasons.unemployedOwner: Without earned income, financing must rely on the value of your property.
reasons.unemployedNoAsset: Without earned income or an asset to pledge, no financing is realistic today.
reasons.filedWithProperty: The listing blocks classic credit, but consolidation backed by your property can be studied.
reasons.filedNoCollateral: A credit-incident listing without an asset to pledge closes access to credit while it runs.
reasons.highDebtRatioOwner: Your expenses weigh heavily, but consolidating your loans around your property can ease the budget.
reasons.tightCapacity: Your repayment capacity is narrow: the file holds, provided it is strengthened.
reasons.youngIndependant: Your business is recent: lenders usually expect more track record and accounts.
reasons.shortContract: A short contract weakens the file in a lender's eyes, without making it impossible.
reasons.shortSeniority: Your track record is still short: a few more months will clearly strengthen the file.
reasons.healthyStable: Stable situation and sound repayment capacity: your file starts on good footing.
reasons.healthyIndependant: Established business and sound capacity: your self-employed file starts on good footing.
reasons.checkFiling: Your situation is favourable; it remains to clear up any doubt about a listing before going further.

levers.consolidate: Consolidate your running loans to reduce the overall monthly payment.
levers.reduceCharges: Ease a recurring expense before filing your request.
levers.addDownPayment: Add personal funds to lower the financed amount.
levers.coBorrower: Present a co-borrower to strengthen the file's income.
levers.gainSeniority: Gain a few more months of track record in your situation.
levers.propertyAppraisal: Have your property appraised to assess the collateral available.
levers.provideBilans: Gather your accounts to evidence the steadiness of your income.
levers.waitDelisting: Wait for the listing to be lifted, or request its regularisation.
levers.verifyFiling: Check your situation with your central bank (free right of access).

resources.mediationBanqueDeFrance: Your central bank informs you, free of charge, about your listing and the ways to regularise it.
resources.debtCounseling: A budget advice service can help you clean up the situation before any credit.
